profile.headline: Senior Pool Engineer & Researcher at MARA — Stratum V2 Working Group rep · mining pools, difficulty adjustment
profile.summary: I'm a senior pool engineer and researcher at MARA, working on the software between miners and the Bitcoin network — mining pool development and operations. I represent MARA in the Stratum V2 Working Group, and most of my current work is in the SV2 reference implementation: difficulty adjustment, share accounting, and the failure modes that only appear at pool scale.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- MARA's representative to the Stratum V2 Working Group.
 - Difficulty adjustment (vardiff) for pool-side Stratum V2 — hardware measurement of how the deployed controller behaves at production scale, and an open proposal replacing its estimator and fire trigger.
 - Share accounting and payout variance, including where the cost of a control decision actually lands.
 - Pool-scale robustness: the failure modes that only show up with many concurrent miners and long-lived channels.
 - Monitoring/metrics: improving the observability of pool internals to simplify operations and maintenance. 
 - Contributor to the Stratum V2 reference implementation.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Spearheaded the original development of Reactor as an NFT-based cloud mining solution, laying the foundation for a unique approach to decentralized mining operations.
- Led a strategic pivot from Ethereum to Bitcoin Lightning, aligning the platform with a more scalable and cost-effective blockchain solution.
- Integrated Stripe payment processing to facilitate seamless and secure transactions, enhancing user experience and operational efficiency.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth transition and implementation of new technologies, while maintaining project timelines and quality standards.

positions.title: Blockchain Consultant
positions.description: Bitcoin and Cryptocurrency specialist. Having studied, invested in and experimented with various distributed systems technologies throughout my software engineering career I have developed a deep technical understanding of the technology underpinning cryptocurrencies as well as the practical aspects and uses of these technologies as they exist today. Including e-commerce, self-custody, lightning network applications and more.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I currently work on internal multi-cloud enablement, price optimization, and cloud service development.

Designed & developed org-wide AWS resource reporting tool. Streaming service deployed on-prem to a k8s cluster using spring-boot + redis and deployed using terraform, CloudWatchEvents and SQS.

Role was to manage cloud resources and costs. Cut per instance costs in half by increasing spot instance adoption in Jenkins. I created preemption agents to notify a custom Jenkins plugin and update the UI.

Rewrote instance provisioning pipeline with native cloud sdks, later enhanced to use batch calls for improved throughput.

Developed an a-la-cart process for updating EC2 images. Users submit code review with a link to a successful run of new image validation tests via Jenkins.

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description: Developed AWS-focused hybrid migration and cloud native solutions of various kinds for clients.

positions.title: Sr. Cloud Engineer & Consultant
positions.description:
Oversaw high-profile client engagements focusing on migration of enterprise environments to AWS. Architectural refactoring focused on scalability, reliability, security hardening and traceability. Clients brought a diverse mix of problem domains including Fortune 500 ecommerce, life sciences, consumer mobile, and financial analytics.

I lead development for the EnvironmentBase project, our premiere open source AWS rapid infrastructure development platform. It's currently being used to deploy production infrastructure of several major clients. 

Other projects included: CI/CD pipelines (multiple implementations using various tools: jenkins, packer, chef, puppet, ansible, vagrant, CloudFormation, pretty much all of the AWS services, ...), AWS IAM account configuration with multiple environments and integrated Octa-based SSO, On demand WordPress site migration to S3, 

Received multiple AWS certifications, participated in hiring and engagement discovery & screening calls, authored blog posts, attended community events and social media forums. Provided training on AWS automation best practices both internally and on-site with clients.

positions.title: Technical Consultant / Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
As a core member of the Platform D team, my responsibilities are to enhance developer relations for our clients and to develop our web-based community management tool campsite.org.  

Our tool enables niche communities to coordinate and share knowledge through physical and digital interaction (meetups, un-conferences, webinars, workshops, forums, etc).  As one of the primary developers my responsibilities span the gamut of full-stack development.

In addition to my core development responsibilities I also do developer relations consulting work in a number of technical areas:  Database, Cloud, DevOps, REST APIs, Node.js, PHP, distributed systems.  Workshops, Getting Started guides, lightning talks, white papers, Tech demos for conferences, etc.  

Recent contracts:  
  
Stackup: SDK for developing and deploying cloud-based web applications.
Sponsored by HPCloud from December 2013 - March 2014
Using Vagrant, Chef and HPCloud integration I developed an SDK for writing LAMP apps in a virtualized environment with a push button deploy to cloud feature. Check it out here: https://github.com/stackalicious/vagrant-env  
  
"Idea to API in Half A Day" Workshop at APIcon 2014 and follow-on whitepaper. 
Sponsored by MuleSoft from March - May 2014
Technical training program introducing concepts and process behind contract-oriented API development using RAML and Node.js. Emphasizing REST, mock services, schema validation and collaborative development process.  
  
Aerospike cluster 1-button deploy with GoGrid.com  
Sponsored by Aerospike from May - June 2014 
Using Ansible I developed a deployment script to launch a cluster of Aerospike NoSQL DB servers.  This feature, demoed at DevOpsDays 2014, will soon be publicly available from GoGrid.com.  Additionally I wrote an easy deployment guide and benchmark table which included the following cloud vendors: Google Compute, Rackspace, Joyent, Digital Ocean, AWS, HPCloud.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented major features in configuration subsystem for Business Process Manager. Primarily the object-relation model and scriptable user access. Additionally I worked on security, scalability, and install/patching processes.

Developed UI components for networked DB2 performance analytics dashboard, Optim Performance Manager, using Adobe Flex, Java, Spring, and OSGI

positions.title: Extreme Blue Internship
positions.description: Overhauled the UI interaction including new data visualizations for a collection of web apps dealing with datacenter resource forecasting and analysis. Our apps dealt with floor and rack space, temperature, energy consumption and water usage. We used Adobe Flex, WebSphere, and DB2 as per request.

positions.title: WebSphere Technical Internship
positions.description: Developed Perl based web app monitoring and management tool.

positions.title: Research Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed a remote data workflow tool to process DNA sequence information. The tool was developed solely by me and resulted in two publications in Bioinformatics journal.

positions.title: Teaching Assistance
positions.description:
Multiple courses throughout undergraduate program:
Introduction to Java
Advanced Java Programming
Java Programming for C programmers

projects.title: Hierarchical Movie Recommender
projects.description: Combined term projects from Data mining and Data visualization.  Mining component was a content based recommender that used IMDB synopisis data to correlate movies to each other.  Visualization component used the top n results from the recommender and organized the results into a tree with labeled grouping concepts (common words from the movie synopisis).  Other data was also depicted in the same graphic using color, size, and shape.

projects.title: Emergent Behavior Simulation
projects.description: Agent based flocking simulation using NetLogo.  Antelope herd formation was modeled using agent based techniques to experiment with emergent flocking behavior.

publications.title: SNAP: Combine and Map modules for multilocus population genetic analysis.
SNAP: Workbench management tool for evolutionary population genetic analysis
